chunks: And it is narrated from Al-Muʿallā ibn Khunays that he said:
Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام saw me when I had delayed going to the market, so he said to me, "Go early to your source of honor."

key_terms.السُّوقِ: the market; the place of trade and livelihood
key_terms.الْمُعَلَّى: Al-Muʿallā, the narrator named in the report
key_terms.عِزِّكَ: your honor, dignity, and source of esteem

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe the value of going early to seek one’s livelihood?
ai.summary: This hadith encourages going early to the marketplace and earning one’s livelihood. It presents lawful work and trade as a source of dignity and honor for a person.
